title: The convergence contract, and every path that has to inherit it
note: require_converged was written for run_coupled and applied there. For a long time those were the ONLY TWO call sites in the repository, while run_mode_sequence_3d -- whose own docstring says it runs the canonical mode order 'exactly mirroring the 1D/2D coupled_mode_solver' -- mirrored the mode order, the state hand-off and the species interlocks, and not this. The tests that existed asserted the helper rejects a hand-made object with solver_status='failed'; that proves the function works and says nothing about whether anything calls it, which was the defect. SC1-SC3 attack the 3D call sites, SC4-SC5 the two halves of the contract itself, SC6 the energy accounting that quadratured an extrapolation over a failed solve, SC7 a reduction check taken outside the sequence.

mutations.name: SC1_the_3d_MODE_B_solve_is_not_checked
mutations.find:
tB = require_converged(
        solve_thermal_3d(cfg, g3, source_mode="averaged",
mutations.rationale: restores the defect at the first solve: everything downstream -- Mode C, readiness, the campaign state, the falsification report, the machine FSM -- is built on an integration nobody asked about

mutations.name: SC2_the_3d_MODE_C_solve_is_not_checked
mutations.find:
tC = require_converged(
        solve_thermal_3d(cfg, g3, source_mode="averaged", source_scale=0.0,
mutations.rationale: Mode C decides readiness and Mode D is constructed only if it holds, so a non-converged recovery solve that still yields a recool time is a readiness verdict taken from an integration that did not finish

mutations.rationale: the sensing-hold thermal state; a hold nobody integrated to completion is not a hold

mutations.name: SC4_the_contract_accepts_any_status
mutations.find:
status = getattr(result, "solver_status", None)
    if status != SOLVER_OK:
mutations.rationale: the contract itself goes quiet, and every call site inherits a check that checks nothing

mutations.name: SC5_a_truncated_trajectory_is_accepted
mutations.find: if not getattr(sol_obj, "success", False):
mutations.rationale: a failed integration returns a SHORTER trajectory, every value finite, so assert_finite passes and a caller pairing so.y with its t_eval holds two arrays of different lengths

mutations.name: SC6_the_energy_accounting_extrapolates_over_a_failed_solve
mutations.find: if not converged:
mutations.rationale: removes the short circuit, so the accounting quadratures the solver's interpolant across the whole requested window on a failed solve. An OdeSolution asked past the interval it covers extrapolates its final polynomial rather than refusing, so the missing time is CONSTRUCTED and integrated. Retargeted from the NaN it used to attack: NaN stopped the arithmetic being believed, and the short circuit stops it being performed

mutations.name: SC7_a_reduction_check_compares_against_a_non_answer
mutations.find: require_converged(r3, "reduction_3d_to_1d: 3D solve")
mutations.rationale: these solves are taken outside run_mode_sequence_3d, so enforcing it there does not reach them; the comparison then measures the distance between one answer and one non-answer and reports a rel_error with a within_tolerance verdict

mutations.name: SC8_the_failed_branch_reports_a_residual_anyway
mutations.find:
"converged": False,
            "accounting": "UNAVAILABLE_INTEGRATION_INCOMPLETE",
mutations.rationale: a failed solve announces itself as converged, so every consumer reading that flag rather than solver_status treats the unavailable accounting as a real one

mutations.name: SC9_the_failed_branch_hides_how_far_it_got
mutations.find: "integrated_to_s": float(tt[-1]) if tt.size else 0.0,
mutations.rationale: the diagnostic claims the integration reached the requested end, which is the one fact a reader needs to see it did not -- and makes the anti-vacuity assertion in the test vacuous

mutations.name: SC10_the_convergence_report_measures_against_a_non_answer
mutations.find:
base = require_converged(solve_thermal_3d(cfg, ci, n_eval=13),
                             "convergence_report: CI-mesh solve")
mutations.rationale: the baseline every other number in the report is measured against; a truncated one is sampled earlier and reads cooler, so both the mesh and the time verdict become statements about when the solver stopped

mutations.name: SC11_the_refined_mesh_solve_is_not_checked
mutations.find:
ref = require_converged(solve_thermal_3d(cfg, refined, n_eval=13),
                            "convergence_report: refined-mesh solve")
mutations.rationale: the refined solve IS the mesh check; the finer mesh is the likelier one to stiffen, and a failure there produces a probe difference that certifies mesh convergence from a shorter integration

mutations.name: SC12_the_tightened_integration_solve_is_not_checked
mutations.find:
tight = require_converged(
            solve_thermal_3d(cfg, ci, n_eval=13,
                             max_step_divisor=MAX_STEP_DIVISOR_TIGHT),
            "convergence_report: tightened-integration solve")
mutations.rationale: the time-convergence verdict; tightening rtol by 10x and halving max_step is exactly what makes this the solve most likely to fail, and its failure would be reported as time convergence

mutations.name: SC13_a_sensitivity_is_reported_from_a_failed_solve
mutations.find:
r = require_converged(solve_thermal_3d(cfg, CI, n_eval=9),
                          "sensitivity_3d: probe-rise solve")
mutations.rationale: every perturbation goes through _rise; a perturbed configuration is the one that stiffens, and its truncated probe reads cooler, so an unguarded failure flips the SIGN of the published sensitivity rather than adding noise

mutations.name: SC14_the_mdao_screening_response_is_not_checked
mutations.find:
r = require_converged(
        solve_thermal_3d(c, SCREENING_MESH, n_eval=SCREENING_N_EVAL),
        "mdao screening response")
mutations.rationale: the function the OpenMDAO component and the tests share, evaluated at design points chosen to be extreme; a failure there enters an optimisation as a real objective value

mutations.name: SC15_the_salib_screening_response_is_not_checked
mutations.find:
r = require_converged(
        solve_thermal_3d(cfg, SCREENING_MESH, n_eval=SCREENING_N_EVAL),
        "salib screening response")
mutations.rationale: Sobol sampling deliberately visits the corners of the parameter box; the samples that fail are the ones the index is most sensitive to

mutations.name: SC16_the_heavy_pass_writes_from_a_failed_solve
mutations.find:
rh = require_converged(solve_thermal_3d(cfg, mesh, n_eval=13),
                           "runner_3d: heavy opt-in pass")
mutations.rationale: the only 3D consumer in the package that solves directly instead of through the mode sequence; it writes a probe timeseries, a hotspot table and an energy accounting from whatever comes back

mutations.name: SC17_the_1d_mesh_convergence_verdict_ignores_the_status_it_prints
mutations.find:
r = require_converged(
            solve_thermal_1d(cfg, source_mode="averaged", n_cells=n,
                             n_eval=30),
            f"mesh_convergence_1d: n={n}")
mutations.rationale: this function records solver_status in a row beside the metric and computes thermal_1d_converged from the same result regardless -- verbatim the shape require_converged's own docstring says it was written to remove

mutations.name: SC18_the_2d_mesh_convergence_verdict_is_not_checked
mutations.find:
r = require_converged(
            solve_thermal_2d(cfg, source_mode="averaged", n_r=nr, n_z=nz,
                             n_eval=12),
            f"mesh_convergence_2d: {tag}")

mutations.name: SC19_the_axis_symmetry_check_is_not_checked
mutations.find:
r = require_converged(
        solve_thermal_2d(cfg, source_mode="averaged", n_r=32, n_z=40,
                         n_eval=10),
        "axis_symmetry_2d")
mutations.replace:
r = solve_thermal_2d(cfg, source_mode="averaged", n_r=32, n_z=40,
                         n_eval=10)
mutations.rationale: a truncated field has a SMALLER axis gradient because it has had less time to develop one, so a failed solve is more likely to certify axis symmetry than a converged one

mutations.name: SC20_the_reduction_comparison_accepts_a_failed_1d_side
mutations.find:
r1 = require_converged(
        solve_thermal_1d(cfg, source_mode="averaged",
                         n_cells=cfg.solver.n_z_2d, n_eval=20),
        "reduction_2d_to_1d: 1D solve")
mutations.rationale: the check is a COMPARISON, so a non-answer on either side is enough; two solves that both stopped early agree with each other

mutations.name: SC21_the_reduction_comparison_accepts_a_failed_2d_side
mutations.find:
r2 = require_converged(
        solve_thermal_2d(cfg, source_mode="averaged", n_r=24,
                         n_z=cfg.solver.n_z_2d, n_eval=12,
                         disable_radial=True),
        "reduction_2d_to_1d: 2D radial-disabled solve")
mutations.replace:
r2 = solve_thermal_2d(cfg, source_mode="averaged", n_r=24,
                          n_z=cfg.solver.n_z_2d, n_eval=12,
                          disable_radial=True)
mutations.rationale: the other side of the same comparison; killed only by a test that injects on the 2D side rather than assuming one guard stands for both

mutations.name: SC22_a_coupling_is_confirmed_by_a_failed_solve
mutations.find:
rT = require_converged(
        solve_thermal_1d(cfg, source_mode="averaged", n_cells=80,
                         n_eval=20),
        "coupling_checks: optical-feeds-thermal solve")
mutations.rationale: the documented optical-to-thermal coupling is confirmed by a hotspot above base temperature, and a diverging solve produces a very large hotspot; the check most likely to be confirmed by failure

mutations.name: SC23_the_uq_recovery_solve_is_not_checked
mutations.find:
rC = require_converged(
                solve_thermal_1d(cfg_off, source_mode="averaged",
                                 n_cells=80, n_eval=40,
                                 T_init=rB.T[:, -1],
                                 t_end=base.solver.recovery_window_s),
                "uncertainty: Mode-C recovery solve")
mutations.replace:
rC = solve_thermal_1d(cfg_off, source_mode="averaged",
                                  n_cells=80, n_eval=40,
                                  T_init=rB.T[:, -1],
                                  t_end=base.solver.recovery_window_s)
mutations.rationale: Mode B is checked in this loop and the recovery solve was not; a truncated recovery reports a faster recool time AND a final temperature that never finished cooling, both in the direction of the readiness flag it feeds

mutations.name: SC24_the_uq_mesh_check_accepts_two_truncated_answers
